qa_pairs.question: What kind of statistics are displayed under the "Ordonnancement" tab in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Ordonnancement" tab in the Metrix portal presents statistics on the allocated CPU cores and GPUs of the cluster.

qa_pairs.question: What timeframes are available for viewing statistics in the "Ordonnancement" tab?
qa_pairs.answer: For the statistics presented in the "Ordonnancement" tab, users can view data for the last week, the last day, or the last hour.
